theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Modified for Data Console
theme_and_archetype.rationale: To convey trust, security, and technical precision, we are using a dark-mode, high-contrast Swiss grid approach. Deep gray/black backgrounds paired with highly saturated status accents ensure clear data legibility without visual fatigue. No purple/teal slop.

data_and_code.usage: Use for all numerical values, stats, API keys, logs, and status badges.

spacing_and_layout.tables: Top-aligned, tabular nums, monospace fonts for data columns. Left-sticky for primary identifier (e.g., dataset name).
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Right-align numerical columns to stack decimal points perfectly. Do not use generic centered layouts.

components.strategy: Shadcn UI tailored for data density and technical console feel.
components.buttons: rounded-sm font-medium, use primary_accent for main CTA, surface colors with border for secondary. ALWAYS apply explicit text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-white).
components.cards: Minimalism. 1px solid border (#27272A). Flat bg (#121214). NO drop shadows. rounded-sm.
components.badges: Flat background with 10% opacity of the status color, 1px solid border of 20% opacity of status color, text in 100% status color. Font: JetBrains Mono text-xs.
components.inputs: Flat, rounded-sm, bg-surface, border-border, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary_accent focus:border-primary_accent. No glowing shadows.
components.charts: Shadcn Charts (Recharts). Grid lines should be very subtle (#27272A). Tooltips must have dark solid backgrounds (#09090B) and 1px border. Sparklines used in tables.

auth.layout: Split screen. Left: Abstract network visual with dark overlay (bg-black/50). Right: Minimalist login/register form.
auth.features: Form to create tenant and first admin user. Use Shadcn forms.

dashboard_shell.layout: Top navigation bar (border-b border-border bg-background). Left side: Logo and Tenant Name (JetBrains Mono). Right side: User avatar and Settings dropdown.
dashboard_shell.content: Empty state should use an ASCII art or monospace placeholder icon to maintain the technical vibe.

datasets_list.layout: Full width data table with pagination.
datasets_list.features: Status badges for 'uploading', 'scanning', 'profiling', 'ready', 'failed'. Use right-aligned actions column.

dataset_upload.layout: Center-focused bento grid (NOT standard centered, but structured grid with distinct dropzone and realtime feedback panel).
dataset_upload.features: Large drag-drop zone (border-dashed border-2 border-border/50 hover:border-primary_accent). Real-time progress bars with JetBrains Mono percentages.

dataset_detail.layout: Top section: High-level dataset metadata. Main section: Dense data table for deterministic profile output.
dataset_detail.features: Columns: Name, Type, Null Count, Cardinality, Summary Stats. Include Shadcn sparkline/mini-bar chart in the Summary Stats column. Use monospace for all numbers.

admin_audit.features: Monospace timestamp column. Event type badges. Plain text log descriptions. High density.

settings.layout: Left sidebar for settings navigation (Profile, API Keys, Sessions), right pane for content.
settings.features: API Keys hidden (bullet mask) with 'Reveal' button. Sessions list with 'Revoke' button (use red/critical accent for destructive actions).

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Use text-white on primary accents.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: ALL interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Format: kebab-case, role-based. e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='upload-dropzone', data-testid='revoke-session-button'.

auth_background.description: Abstract data network pattern for auth screen left panel

user_avatar.description: Professional user avatar for top right dashboard shell

logo_symbol.description: Minimalist corporate logo symbol for top left branding

instructions_to_main_agent: Import Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, and JetBrains Mono fonts into index.css or via Google Fonts link.
Implement Shadcn UI using the CLI, prioritizing Table, Form, Input, Button, Card, Badge, Tabs, DropdownMenu.
Strictly follow 1px border and flat background styles for Cards to achieve the 'Console' look. Avoid shadows.
Ensure ALL buttons, links, and forms have data-testid attributes.
Use JS (not TSX), ensuring components are written in Javascript.
Avoid generic centered layouts by utilizing full-width or strictly gridded asymmetric sections.
